title: Change-request brief
description: Structured brief for one Jira MOD change request, written to runs/<CR-KEY>/cr_brief.json. A brief is ready only when nothing blocks design; otherwise missing_information lists every blocking question.

cr_key.description: Jira key of the change request, e.g. MOD-3.

summary.description: One or two sentences restating the change in plain language. Must not add rules the ticket does not state.

programs.description: Legacy PROGRAM-IDs affected (from INVENTORY.md), e.g. CBL0001. Empty only when the brief is not ready.

fields.description: COBOL data names read, written or added by the change, e.g. ACCT-BALANCE. New fields use the name proposed in the brief.

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable statements, each checkable by an automated test. Taken from the ticket, not invented.

risk.description: Delivery risk: high if money arithmetic, record layouts or PII handling change.

pii.description: True if any listed field is flagged PII = Yes or Possible in data-dictionary.md.

missing_information.description: Questions that must be answered before design can start. Empty when ready.

question.description: A specific question a business owner can answer.

why_it_blocks.description: What cannot be designed, built or tested until this is answered.

ready.description: True only when missing_information is empty and programs and acceptance_criteria are filled.
